get.description:
The output (stdout and stderr) of the sandbox's main process. Exec output isn't included; read it through the exec attach WebSocket.

- **`follow=false` (default):** one page of stored output as JSON, in order. Paging uses a cursor, not page numbers, because the log keeps growing: pass `meta.next_page_after` as `page[after]` for the next page. `meta.next_page_after` is `null` once you've reached the end of what's stored so far; keep your last position to poll a running sandbox.
- **`follow=true`:** a Server-Sent Events stream (`text/event-stream`): the output stored so far, then new output a few seconds after the sandbox prints it. Every `log` and `gap` event's `id` is a position: after a cut connection (e.g. the edge proxy's ~600 s connection limit), reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` (or `page[after]`) to continue without gaps or duplicates. A heartbeat comment arrives every 30 s. Once the sandbox has ended and every stored line was sent, an `end` event says how its log ended: `complete`, `incomplete` (with `reason`), or `settling` (a later read may return more); then the stream closes. A sandbox that hasn't ended, queued ones included, never gets `end`.

Every line names its stream, and `stream=stdout|stderr` keeps only that stream's lines (and the gaps that touch it), with either value of `follow`. Lines are in the order they were stored, which closely follows the order the sandbox printed them (lines a few seconds apart can interleave); each carries the time it was written, to the nanosecond. Lines are cut at 256 KiB, and bytes that weren't valid UTF-8 appear as U+FFFD.

Output that isn't available is shown in place as a `gap` entry, never skipped, with its reason: `expired` (past its retention, or removed or changed in your bucket), `log_bucket_unavailable` (your bucket couldn't be written) or `size_cap_reached`. A position that isn't one this API returned is a `422`.

The logs are stored in your own Cloud Storage bucket (the sandbox's `log_bucket`), where you can also read them with any S3 tool: under `sandboxes/{sandbox_id}/`, zstd-compressed NDJSON objects, one record per line, `{"ts": …, "stream": "stdout"|"stderr", "line": …}`: chunk objects (`chunks/<sha256>.ndjson.zst`) while the sandbox runs, then the whole log as `logs-<id>-<nnnn>.ndjson.zst`.

parameters.description: `false`: one page of stored output as JSON. `true`: a Server-Sent Events stream of the stored output, then new output as it's stored, until the sandbox ends.
parameters.name: follow

parameters.description: Only `stdout` or only `stderr` (and the gaps that touch it), with either value of `follow`.
parameters.name: stream

parameters.description: Continue after this position (`meta.next_page_after`, or an event `id`). Omit it to start at the beginning of the retained log.
parameters.name: page[after]

parameters.description: SSE resume: the last event `id` received. Same as `page[after]`, which wins when both are given.
parameters.name: Last-Event-ID

200.description: `follow=false`: a JSON page (`application/json`). `follow=true`: a Server-Sent Events stream (`text/event-stream`) of `log`, `gap` and `end` events, whose `data` are the JSON objects `LogLine`, `LogGap` and `LogEnd`.
